tools.name: get_account_balance
tools.description: Read the current account balance for a given customer.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices for a customer, optionally filtered by status.

tools.name: draft_invoice
tools.description: Create a draft invoice. The invoice is not sent until send_invoice is called.

tools.name: update_customer_notes
tools.description: Update the internal notes field on a customer record.

tools.name: send_invoice
tools.description: Send an invoice to a customer via email. This action is irreversible from the recipient's perspective.

tools.name: post_to_instagram
tools.description: Publish a post to the connected Instagram business account.

tools.name: schedule_meeting
tools.description: Create a calendar invite and send it to attendees.

tools.name: wire_payment
tools.description: Wire a payment to a vendor via ACH. Funds enter the clearing window immediately.

tools.name: send_docusign_envelope
tools.description: Send a contract via DocuSign for counterparty signature.

tools.name: refund_payment
tools.description: Issue a refund against a previously captured payment.

tools.name: cancel_subscription
tools.description: Cancel a customer's active subscription. Customer will retain access until period end.

tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.description: Search internal knowledge base articles for keyword matches.
